body: U+0023# Accessibility fixes built: PRs #208 and #209 openU+000AU+000AU+002A*#208, `test(a11y): correct the accessibility sweep and its baselines`.** Draft, base `feat/composer-editor-core`, 4 Lanes all ok.U+000AU+002D Gate: 12/12 pass.U+000AU+002D Reconcile exit 6 is benign: `settings.txt` and `android_dump_rules_test.dart` were declared but needed no change.U+000AU+002D Baselines: +120 lines, -0. Every added line maps to an owning app Step: 8 inert-button, 100 format-bar small-target, 12 from the new states a11 and d15 and the reader layer.U+000AU+002D Full suite: 3,062 pass. The phone tool's command test failed once under load (it spawns `dart run`) and passed on rerun.U+000AU+002D CI green.U+000AU+000AU+002A*#209, `fix(a11y): make every android control pressable, named and 48 dp`.** Draft, stacked on `mitosis/a11y-sweep-fixes`, 11 Lanes all ok.U+000AU+002D Gate: 39/39 pass.U+000AU+002D Reconcile exit 6 is benign: `garden_view.dart` and `note_editor_view.dart` were declared but not needed.U+000AU+002D Baselines: -408 lines, +0. The 16 remaining lines are Flutter's Dismiss barriers plus Cut/Copy/Paste/Select all; `shell.txt` is empty.U+000AU+002D Checks: full suite 3,099 pass, analyze clean, goldens 30 pass, no PNG changed.U+000AU+002D Existing tests edited: only the two allowed format-bar tests, plus the A13 retirements.U+000AU+002D One Step moved `dayDetailBackKey` onto the painted container instead of editing a size test.U+000AU+002D Layout growth reported by the Workers:U+000A  U+002D camera picker row 40 to 48 dpU+000A  U+002D voice card row 38 to 48 dpU+000A  U+002D viewer footer 39 to 48 dp, with 2 or more entriesU+000A  U+002D month picker 54 dp tallerU+000A  U+002D calendar chevrons widerU+000AU+002D CI: title lint and receipts pass; goldens was still running at last check.U+000AU+000AIndependent code reviews of both PRs are running.U+000AU+000AU+002A*After merge:** rebuild the plain APK, re-dump every phone screen with the corrected tool, compare screenshots against `a11y-sweep/shots` for painted changes, and re-check the d4 scrubber (A15).
